crossRefs.note: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in…
There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to…
All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world…

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
translations.bsb: So the sons of Israel were among those who came to buy grain, since the famine had also spread to the land of Canaan.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
translations.asv: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
